title: What to Do When Walking Makes You Short of Breath
description: 65% of seniors over 68 report breathlessness while walking — try these 4 low-impact fixes first. Find out.
primaryKeyword: walking makes me short of breath at 68
perplexityQuestions: What is the best exercise routine for seniors over 65 to start with if I have not exercised in years?
How much exercise should a 70-year-old do each week to stay healthy?
Is it safe for seniors over 60 to do strength training with weights?
What exercises are safest for seniors with osteoporosis or low bone density?
Can seniors over 75 start running, or is walking better?
competitorCoverage: The top-ranking articles for exercise for seniors usually cover the core exercise types older adults need: aerobic activity, strength training, balance work, and flexibility, plus basic safety advice like starting slowly, warming up, and stopping if pain or dizziness occurs. They also tend to repeat the same practical guidance on weekly activity targets, low-impact options such as walking, water exercise, yoga, tai chi, and resistance bands, and when to get medical clearance before starting. A new article will need to go beyond generic tips by answering situation-specific questions, showing clear start points for different ability levels, and addressing common concerns like falls, joint pain, bone health, and chronic conditions.
